map.📖 查看「Lorem 占位文本生成器使用指南」: 📖 View the "Lorem Placeholder Text Generator User Guide"
map.Lorem Ipsum 是排版设计中常用的无意义拉丁文占位文本，能让读者聚焦版面: Lorem Ipsum is the meaningless Latin placeholder text commonly used in typesetting, letting readers focus on the layout rather than the content. Choose the number of paragraphs to generate standard paragraphs, convenient for filling prototypes and samples.
map.占位文本按段落生成：每段由 4 至 7 个句子组成、每句 10 至 18 个单词: The placeholder text is generated by paragraph: each paragraph consists of 4 to 7 sentences of 10 to 18 words each, drawn from a standard Lorem Ipsum Latin word list of about 70 words; the first sentence of a paragraph starts with a capital letter and ends with a period, words are separated by a single space; the generated amount = paragraph count × average sentence count × average sentence length (words), used for prototype filling and layout samples.
map.Lorem Ipsum 源自西塞罗《善恶之尽》的拉丁文段落打乱，自 16 世纪起: Lorem Ipsum derives from a scrambled Latin passage of Cicero's "De Finibus Bonorum et Malorum"; since the 16th century the printing industry has used it as placeholder copy, and to this day it is a design convention.
map.本工具随机拼接词表生成，并非固定经典原文，但风格一致，足够用于版面铺满与字体预览: This tool randomly concatenates words from a word list; it is not the fixed classic text, but the style is consistent and sufficient for filling the layout and previewing fonts.
map.正式文案上线前应替换占位文本，避免把 Lorem Ipsum 误发布到生产页面。: Placeholder text should be replaced before the official copy goes live, to avoid mistakenly publishing Lorem Ipsum to a production page.
map.做网页/海报/UI 原型时，需要一段无意义的占位文字撑起版式，快速生成若干段排版: When making a web page / poster / UI prototype, you need a meaningless placeholder text to support the layout and quickly generate several typesetting samples.
map.给设计稿或演示文档填充示例文本，避免用真实内容导致评审误解为终稿。: Fill design drafts or presentation documents with sample text, avoiding the use of real content that makes reviewers mistake it for the final draft.
map.测试文字溢出、换行、字体适配时，用随机长度拉丁文段落验证布局健壮性。: When testing text overflow, line wrapping and font adaptation, use randomly lengthed Latin paragraphs to verify layout robustness.

map.每次生成的内容一样吗？: Is the content the same every time?
map.不一样。单词按随机顺序拼接，但都来自同一套标准 Lorem Ipsum 词库，保: No. Words are concatenated in random order but all come from the same standard Lorem Ipsum word bank, ensuring it is "Latin-like" placeholder text rather than real semantics.
map.能指定段数和句子数吗？: Can I specify the number of paragraphs and sentences?
map.本工具按段落数（1–10）生成，每段为随机单词串；如需更精细的长度控制，可多次生: This tool generates by paragraph count (1–10), each paragraph being a random word string; for finer length control, generate multiple times and then crop manually.
